summary.text: Marc Lee is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 74 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes working as a captain with the Butte-Silver Bow Fire Department.

paragraphs.text: Lee took office on January 6, 2025, and for the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, Local Government, and State Administration committees.
